newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro Pacific sees 1997 net 1.1 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Metro Pacific sees 1997 net 1.1 bln pesos.

text.p: Diversified firm Metro Pacific Corp was expecting a net income of at least 1.1 billion pesos in 1997, the company's executive director Seumas Gallacher said on Friday.
About 65 percent of the income was expected to come from its telecommunications and property affiliates, Gallacher told reporters after the company's annual stockholders meeting.
Metro Pacific, a unit of Hong Kong's First Pacific Co Ltd, posted a net income of 843.9 million pesos in 1996.
Earlier on Friday, Metro Pacific announced it made a 1997 first quarter net income of 200.5 million pesos, sharply up from 90.5 million year-ago.
Metro Pacific has a stake in Fort Bonifacio Land Corp which is building a new commercial city next to the existing business district of Makati.
It's other affiliates are cellular phone firm Smart Telecommunications Inc, packaging firm Steniel Manufacturing Corp and PDCP Development Bank.
